items.title: ‘We are committed Christians’: Our son and daughter-in-law cut us out of their lives after a political argument. Should we change our $3 million will?
items.description: “We are hurt and confused, but we have also tried to respect the boundaries they have established.”

items.title: ‘There is considerable tension’: My grandmother, 99, wants to cut my mother out of her will. Should I intervene?
items.description: “Grandma feels that she was pressured by my mother into taking out a $50,000 HELOC.”

items.title: Here’s some surprisingly good news for the stock market this midterm election year
items.description: There is a strong historical pattern of postmidterm strength.

items.title: ‘The estrangement isn’t about politics’: My daughter hasn’t spoken to me for 4 years. Do I leave her a monthly annuity?
items.description: “You’ll have to trust me when I tell you that she had love, support and opportunities.”

items.title: A massive ‘corporate welfare’ program is underway — and consumers want a bigger cut of it
items.description: Tariff refunds have been flowing back to companies since President Donald Trump’s levies were rejected by the Supreme Court.

items.title: ‘She’s desperate’: My friend was laid off and lost her health insurance. How can she find affordable coverage?
items.description: “She looked into COBRA, but the cost is absolutely ridiculous.”

items.title: This has been one of the most affordable U.S. cities to buy a home for the past 134 years
items.description: Home prices in America have changed dramatically over the last century — but the Midwest has remained a bastion of affordability through it all.

items.title: You can now Venmo your kid’s college tuition. But should you?
items.description: Some universities will begin accepting the nontraditional payment method as consumers seek flexible spending options.

items.title: Soon you can buy Medicare Advantage plans at Costco. What you need to know.
items.description: The warehouse club becomes the latest consumer brand to offer health insurance.

items.title: Tesla’s stock jumps as the company gets cleared for a Las Vegas robotaxi launch
items.description: The automaker plans to soon launch its Cybercab in Austin, Texas, and got the nod to deploy thousands of vehicles in Nevada.
